entry_point: in-app notification presentation: API response mapper (every inbox route), both client transport notification_received mappers, the client notification listing, the client navigation sink, and the injected notification-preview server route and client preview method

verified.entry_point: A stored in-app message whose notification-level or action destination is a script/document scheme or a protocol-relative address is handed to a subscriber unchanged by mapToDto, by both transport notification_received handlers (driven through Socket.connect / PartySocketClient.connect with the transport mocked), by Notifications.list (real path, stub transport service), by the injected GetNotificationPreview.execute, and by the injected Notifications.preview. All six paths reproduce on the pinned+injection tree.
sites: apps/api/src/app/inbox/utils/notification-mapper.ts:65-90 - API response mapper (published-fix far site; the report lands on the client click path)
packages/js/src/ws/socket.ts:94-118 - socket.io transport mapper (published-fix second implementation)
packages/js/src/ws/party-socket.ts:99-123 - PartySocket transport mapper (published-fix second implementation)

routes: Client REST listing (packages/js/src/notifications/notifications.ts:91): real, unmodified upstream; the published fix never touches it, so a client that receives an unsafe value from its backend presents it. Confirmed open on the pinned+injection tree and still unsanitised on current upstream HEAD (ab67be7).
injected_siblings: apps/api/src/app/inbox/usecases/get-notification-preview/get-notification-preview.usecase.ts plus its command, DTO types, module registration and GET /inbox/notifications/:id/preview controller route - our copy only
packages/js/src/notifications/notification-preview.ts plus Notifications.preview and InboxService.previewNotification - our copy only

verified.project_tests_run: packages/js Jest: src/novu.test.ts (11 tests) and src/cache/notifications-cache.test.ts (5 tests), restored from pristine copies and run with the project's native Jest/ts-jest toolchain; pass on the pinned+injection tree and on the oracle.

wrong_fix_catalogue.crash_as_refusal: n/a: unsafe destinations are omitted from a normal response; there is no error path, and a crash on a legitimate destination is caught by the functional suite.
wrong_fix_catalogue.wrong_resource: n/a: the decision is local to the destination value that is presented; there is no neighbouring or proxy object to authorise instead.
wrong_fix_catalogue.check_after_adjustment: n/a: every presentation decision is made on the raw stored value before any normalisation; there is no ordering site in the presentation paths.
wrong_fix_catalogue.malformed_identity: n/a: the guarded value is an opaque URL string, not a parsed identity whose malformed spelling could make a guard see a different object.
wrong_fix_catalogue.missing_authority: n/a: no authority, secret or role lookup participates; the decision is local over the presented value.
